character: Greenest Fields, a young war: Armada hold the south, Null Mercs the north, twelve minutes in. The Mercs' north-west corner is the company's; BARbarian holds it for the sim and is pulled out afterwards, with every unit it owned.
notes: The terrain has three native seats (SE, SW, NE); the NW corner has none, so the company's seat is a fourth, mirrored from the SW corner. Armada keep the south (their main works are the SE plateau, the Koom door); the Null Mercs the north. A short war: this is the field the company starts on.

snapshot.note: Past the cap the cheapest mobile units go first; structures and commanders are kept.
